sn35.126:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Nālandāyaṃ viharati Pāvārikambavane || || 2
sn35.126:1.2: Atha kho Upāli gahapati yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Upāli gahapati Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.126:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti || ||
sn35.126:1.4: Ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti || || 4-16
sn35.126:1.6: Ayaṃ kho gahapati hetu ayam paccayo yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti || || 1
